pages.title: All-Hands Notes – Sept 2, 2026
pages.summary: Q3 ARR hit $4.1M end of Aug with board meeting Sept 18, and nobody officially owns the security policy yet.
pages.body:
- Noor: Q3 closing strong, ARR $4.1M end of Aug. Board mtg Sept 18
- Welcome Ana Lindqvist (platform eng) + Jonah Pereira (platform eng)
- Felix: postmortem for Aug 14 outage is up in the eng folder. New migration checklist is mandatory from today
- Wren: growth pricing thread is in #pricing-decisions, decision coming next week
- Rafa: Pantry 2.0 launch Nov 4, webinar Oct 28
- Tobias: expense policy reminder, submit within 30 days. Ledgerline is the only expense tool now (Expensify is gone)
- Ines: offsite in Austin Oct 20-22. Open enrollment for benefits in November

**Q&A:** "Who owns security now?" -> Noor: we're hiring a security lead, Felix covers until then. Nobody officially owns the security policy yet.
gaps: nobody officially owns the security policy yet
growth pricing decision coming next week (not yet decided)
